result.Method of Attack: Double extortion: encrypts files and threatens to release sensitive data if ransom is not paid; terminates processes and services to slow detection; drops ransom note and HTA file for instructions; uses Tox peer-to-peer messaging for attacker contact; drops a desktop background image with ransom instructions
result.Attack Vector: Not currently available, likely similar to other ransomware groups
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note: How To Restore Your Files.txt
